analyzed: yā ca samantabhadrā devatī śūnyatā rūpa ātmikā sā prajñāpāramitā catur devī jñāna ātmikā sphāraṇa saṃharaṇa svabhāvena vyavasthitā śrī mahāvairocana ākāra jñāna pariṇata svabhāvā samantabhadrā prajñāpāramitā śabdena uktā iti

original: kiṃ bahunā , yā samantabhadrā prajñāpāramitā sā 'bhāvarūpā ākāśalakṣaṇatvena śūnyatākārā viviktā prakṛtiprabhāsvarā jñānajñeyarahitā niḥsvabhāvalakṣaṇā dharmakāyapariṇatā satī vaineyajanaṃ prati sambhogakāyena sā vyavasthitā satī nirmāṇādikaṃ pratibhāsate(sayati) | sambhogakāyaścāpi śūnyatālakṣaṇaṃ(ṇaḥ) |
analyzed: kim bahunā yā samantabhadrā prajñāpāramitā sā bhāva rūpā ākāśa lakṣaṇa tvena śūnyatā ākārā viviktā prakṛti prabhāsvarā jñāna jñeya rahitā niḥsvabhāva lakṣaṇā dharmakāya pariṇatā satī vaineya janam prati sambhoga kāyena sā vyavasthitā satī nirmāṇa ādikam sambhoga kāyaḥ ca api śūnyatā lakṣaṇaṃṇaḥ

original: śūnyatā ca sarvākāravaropetatvena vyavasthitā | māyāmarīcisvapnapratibimbapratiśrutyo(tko)dakacandranirmitopamasvabhāvatayā pratipadyata iti | tathā coktam — " kāyaṃ sāmbhogikaṃ śūnyaṃ dharmakāyaṃ nairmāṇakaṃ kṛtvā bhāṣitaṃ sarvabuddhaiḥ " [iti] |
analyzed: śūnyatā ca sarva ākāra vara upeta tvena vyavasthitā māyā marīci svapna pratibimba pratiśrutya utkodaka candra nirmita upama svabhāva tayā pratipadyate iti tathā ca uktam kāyam sāmbhogikam śūnyam dharmakāyam nairmāṇakam kṛtvā bhāṣitam sarva buddhaiḥ iti

original: prajñopāyaśabdena kimucyate ? prajñayā upāyaḥ prajñopāya iti , prajñājanita upāya ityarthaḥ | upāya ityanena śabdena ko 'rtho bhaṇyate ? śrīvajrasattvaḥ saṃsārabhūtaḥ karuṇāsvabhāvaḥ sthiravastusvabhāvamūrtiḥ upāyaśabdenokta iti | upāyaḥ śrīvajrasattva iti | pañcakāyātmakaṃ pañcatathāgatātmakaṃ ca sphāraṇasaṃharaṇasvabhāvena vyavasthitamiti |
analyzed: prajñā upāya śabdena kim ucyate prajñayā upāyaḥ prajñā upāyaḥ iti prajñā janitaḥ upāyaḥ iti arthaḥ upāyaḥ iti anena śabdena kaḥ rthaḥ bhaṇyate śrī vajra sattvaḥ saṃsāra bhūtaḥ karuṇā svabhāvaḥ sthira vastu svabhāva mūrtiḥ upāya śabdena uktaḥ iti upāyaḥ śrī vajra sattvaḥ iti pañca kāya ātmakam pañca tathāgata ātmakam ca sphāraṇa saṃharaṇa svabhāvena vyavasthitam iti

original: vajrapadmasamāyogena [p. 217] prajñāliṅgita ekākārarūpeṇa jñānasvabhāvaṃ bhāvayediti | prajñopāya ityanayordvayoḥ kaḥ sambandhaḥ ? locanādipañcadevatyo bhūtādisvabhāvena śūnyatākārarūpeṇa pariṇatā iti | upāyo 'pi śrīvajrasattvaḥ sarvabhāvasvabhāvaḥ sthiracalasarvabhāvasvabhāvasya yā śūnyatā sā śūnyatākārayogena pariṇatā iti |
analyzed: vajra padma samāyogena prajñā liṅgitaḥ eka ākāra rūpeṇa jñāna svabhāvam bhāvayet iti prajñā upāyaḥ iti anayoḥ dvayoḥ kaḥ sambandhaḥ locana ādi pañca devatyaḥ bhūta ādi svabhāvena śūnyatā ākāra rūpeṇa pariṇatāḥ iti śrīvajra sattvaḥ sarva bhāva svabhāvaḥ sthira cala sarva bhāva svabhāvasya yā śūnyatā sā śūnyatā ākāra yogena pariṇatāḥ iti

original: oṃ hūṃ ityanenākṣaradvayena ekākāramiti | prajñopāyasthāpanārthaṃ dvidhārūpaṃ gataḥ | na ca vajrasattvo dvidhābhāvaṃ yāti | ta(ya)dā śūnyena śūnyatayā 'krāntaṃ bhavati , tadā ekākāraṃ pratibhāsata iti |
analyzed: om hūm iti anena akṣara dvayena eka ākāram iti prajñā upāya sthāpana artham dvidhā rūpam gataḥ na ca vajra sattvaḥ dvidhābhāvam yāti śūnyena śūnyatayā krāntam bhavati tadā eka ākāram pratibhāsate iti

original: anyacca prajñopāyātmakāḥ sarvasattvā iti ye prajñopāyasvabhāvadvaidhībhāvaṃ kurvanti tebhyo vidyāgrahagṛhītāḥ sambhoga(gaṃ) salīlamavalokya pārapatitāstiṣṭhanti | ye punaradvayākāraṃ viśuddhākāratayā tattvarūpaṃ paśyanti bhāvayanti ca , te 'nuttarabodhiphalalābhina iti | tena prajñopāyobhayasvabhāvatayā na kaścid buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ bandhanam |
analyzed: anyat ca prajñā upāya ātmakāḥ sarva sattvāḥ iti ye prajñā upāya svabhāva dvaidhībhāvam kurvanti tebhyaḥ vidyā graha gṛhītāḥ sambhoga gam sa līlam avalokya pāra patitāḥ tiṣṭhanti ye punar advaya ākāram viśuddha ākāra tayā tattva rūpam paśyanti bhāvayanti ca te nuttara bodhi phala lābhinaḥ iti tena prajñā upāya ubhaya svabhāva tayā na kaścid buddhānām bhagavatām bandhanam

original: kaścit paṇḍitaḥ samatāyogena muktirbha(ko bha)vati | tathā coktam -
analyzed: kaścid paṇḍitaḥ samatā yogena mukti rbhakaḥ bhavati tathā ca uktam

analyzed: bajjhanti jeṇa jatāḍā parimuṃcanti teṇa budhā

analyzed: bodhi vibhāvanayā viparītam idam sakalam

analyzed: ayam arthaḥ karuṇaḥ iti karuṇā rahitaḥ yadi śūnyatāyām lagati tadā asī yogī uttama mārgam na labhate buddhatva mārgam na labhate iti yāvat athavā śūnyatā rahitaḥ yadi karuṇā kevalī bhāvyate tadā saṃsārasya muktiḥ na labhyate yaḥ punar yogī bhāva dvayam jñātvā prajñā upāya rāśi dvayam yojayitum śakyate eka ākāram kartum śakyate

analyzed: na tad bhavam na nirvāṇam iti bhavam saṃsāram nirvāṇam buddhatvam iti
